Una bolla di sapone ha due interfacce e raggio 6 mm. Con γ = 0,05 N/m, quale sovrapressione interna serve?

findingsAndLimits.manualProcedure: Soap bubble two spherical interfaces delta_p=4gamma/r; gamma.05 gives delta_p=200/r_mm Pa. Thin soap film with nearly equal inner/outer radii; gamma constant, negligible thickness. Convertmm tom then divide200 by r_mm. Actual200/6=100/3Pa; hand33.33 relative error1/10000, within0.5%.
